title: Read everything about a release through query
statement: As a developer, I can have an agent read everything about a release through change-saga query, the way it reads every other record, so it never has to scrape the reader or learn a one-off command.
overview: Trevor's direction, from a real gap: Plans and Tasks have metadata as JSON but no `query` operation, so an agent reading a Task's essay had to extract it from the rendered viewer. The skill tells agents to read Saga records only through `query`, so a release follows that pattern from the start and does not repeat the gap. The same goes for the test catalog's `query e2e-catalog` and `query e2e-tests`.

acceptance_criteria.statement: `query releases` lists releases and `--release ID|URN` selects one, the same shape as `query personas --persona` and `query quality --test`, with no separate show command.
It returns public notes, internal notes, step excerpts and code references in full, with nothing truncated or left to a reader page.
`query release-template` returns the template's steps, excerpts and versioning scheme the same way.
Each uses the standard envelope, snapshot, pagination and error codes, and `query schema` describes it.
Facts computed about a release, such as what is still open, are also query operations with those same conventions.
